factCards.text: The load line marking on merchant hulls is named after Samuel Plimsoll, whose campaign preceded the United Kingdom's Merchant Shipping Act of 1876.
factCards.sourceTitle: UK Parliament — Merchant Shipping Act 1876 (legislation record)

factCards.text: The okapi was described by Western science only in 1901, though it was long known to Mbuti communities in the Ituri forest.
Antimony compounds have been used as eye cosmetics in North Africa and West Asia since antiquity; how consistently kohl was antimony-based rather than lead-based varies by period and region.
factCards.sourceTitle: British Museum collection notes on ancient cosmetics
